name: @andrewpopov/auth-kit
description: Authentication primitives: bcrypt password hashing (injected impl, cost 12, optional SHA-256 pre-hash + timing-safe dummy hash), single-use SHA-256 opaque tokens (reset/invite/email-change) — both pure and stateless — and refresh-token session rotation with reuse detection: a stateful protocol (family-kill-on-replay, epoch-based global invalidation, opt-in benign-race grace window) run against an injected `RefreshTokenStore` port. Storage, RBAC, and the JWT library stay app-specific. Ships an adapter conformance test suite (`/conformance`) for verifying a real store's atomicity.
author: Andrew Popov
